findings.title: Wrapper CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolution
findings.body: run_native_hooks.sh overwrites CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR with git rev-parse of current directory instead of checking CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR first.

findings.title: Codex hooks inline copy
findings.body: .codex/hooks.json inlines git and venv lookup rather than delegating directly through run_native_hooks.sh wrapper.

findings.title: Global native_hooks_register path
findings.body: native_hooks_register in cli.py only emits wrapper for non-global registration; global registration emits bare python3.

findings.title: Strict validation of legacy pr_merge proofs
findings.body: Removing pattern popping applies strict canonical pattern to older legacy proofs under proof/pr_merge/.

findings.title: find-principals and relative path handling in sign script
findings.body: sign_local_audit_proof.sh selects first principal with head -n 1 and assumes relative paths from working directory.

remaining_risks: run_native_hooks.sh assumes invocation from project repository root
Codex hooks inlined rather than invoking wrapper script
Legacy proof packets under proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit require strict canonical report_path format if modified
